tweets.text:
ILLEGAL ALIEN TRIES TO RUN OVER A BP AGENT!

SAN JUAN, PR- On 6/25, USBP agents spotted a suspicious vehicle parked in an area notorious for illicit activity. As they approached, the smell of marijuana filled the air- the driver was too busy smoking to answer questions. Then, the driver sped off, accelerating towards the agents and nearly running them over. The driver ultimately crashed into a Border Patrol vehicle. IT DIDN'T END THERE... The two individuals jumped out of the car attempting to flee on foot- they were immediately apprehended. 

The driver, an illegal alien from the Dominican Republic now faces charges for assault on a federal agent and will be processed as an inadmissible alien.

Assaulting USBP agents is a FELONY- it will not be tolerated.

Read more:
https://t.co/2qmCFWlmYV
